description.zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
description.en: The account name of the agent. This value is unique within the instance and is used as the logon name.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
